name: recipelogger
description: Connect RecipeLogger to browse and manage your family's recipes, meal plans, shopping lists, shopping habits, and store layouts.

interface.longDescription: Use your RecipeLogger family collection to find recipes, plan meals, and prepare shopping lists. Browse recipes in an interactive gallery, use saved household shopping habits, and organize shopping by store layout. Sign in with your own RecipeLogger account to access your family's data.
defaultPrompt: Find dinner ideas in my family's RecipeLogger recipes.
Help me plan next week's meals using RecipeLogger.
Prepare a shopping list from my RecipeLogger meal plan.
